title: Communal Award and the Poona Pact
quote: Gandhi: separate electorates for Dalits would permanently divide Hindu society

boxes.title: Communal Award (1932)
items: Announced ==**16 August 1932**== by British PM ==**Ramsay MacDonald**==
Context: **2nd RTC** failed over minority representation
Women: **3%** of seats in all provinces except **NWFP**
Special-interest seats: labour, landlords, traders, industrialists

boxes.title: Responses
head: Who
Response
rows: ==**Fast unto death**== from **20 September 1932**, **Yerwada Jail, Poona**
Neither accepted nor rejected the Award

items.what: 2nd RTC fails → **Communal Award** → Gandhi's fast → **Poona Pact**

boxes.title: From Award to Constitution
steps: **Poona Pact**: ==reserved seats in a joint electorate==
Model for **SC reservation** under the Constitution

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: A/R: Award gave each minority seats by separate electorate (UPPSC 2017: both true, R explains A)
